content:
maria_support: Customer (acct: acme-corp, email: ops@acme.com) reports free-trial credits never applied. Support console shows immediate success but customer's balance unchanged. Ticket #SUP-8217. I clicked grant -> modal said 'success' -> console shows 'GRANT_JOB queued' and it never moves to completed. Can someone take a look?

jason_sre: Got it — can you paste the admin console response and any request IDs? Also what's the customer-visible error?

maria_support: Customer sees no UI error, just no credits. From console network tab: 
```
POST https://backoffice.internal/grants 202
{
  "job_id": "job-7f4c2",
  "status": "queued",
  "request_id": "req_ZxY12"
}
```
And in the admin UI logs: `grant-worker: enqueue ok, retry_count=0` then nothing.

kai_eng: I can repro locally hitting the same endpoint with that payload, job is enqueued then the worker picks it up and we publish a grant-event to pubsub. Can you check if pubsub acked? ops-bot, can you surface pubsub errors for job-7f4c2?

ops-bot: pubsub: subscription grant-worker-sub last ack for job-7f4c2: NACK (timeout). 3 attempted deliveries in 24h.

jason_sre: NACKs explain it. Looks like the grant-worker container has been crashing / CPU starved and failing to ack messages. Any recent deploys? kai_eng, can you check worker logs around the first delivery?

kai_eng: Pulling logs now. Found repeated stack traces: 
```
2026-03-17T09:02:13Z grant-worker ERROR: KV cache locked for > 120s
2026-03-17T09:02:15Z grant-worker ERROR: panic: deadlock detected in grant-processor
stack: ...
```
Seems a deadlock in the grant-processor around token-bucket refill and DB transaction ordering. This would cause NACKs and retry loops.

helen_product: Is this the same root cause as last month's credit-applier bug? We rolled a hotfix then.

kai_eng: Related surface but different module. Last time was rate-limiter order; this is a grant tx lock where we attempt to update customer_balance then emit event inside the same pinned DB tx causing row locks with the webhook writer. Quick mitigation: increase worker replicas and restart workers to drain queue; long-term: reorder operations to emit event after committing tx.

maria_support: Customer is asking for an immediate fix — can we manually credit them for now and close the ticket?

jason_sre: Manual fix is ok as emergency. Proposed safe SQL (run from readonly session? no, needs write):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE accounts SET credits = credits + 500 WHERE id = 'acct:acme-corp' AND credits_locked = false;
INSERT INTO grants (id, account_id, amount, source, created_by) VALUES ('manual-1771234567','acct:acme-corp',500,'support-manual','maria_support');
COMMIT;
```
Please only run with DB write access and create a support ticket note. Kai, can you also publish a synthetic grant-event after commit so downstream systems get consistent state?

kai_eng: I can run the synthetic event publisher but prefer to run after DB commit. I'll coordinate with infra to run a controlled restart of grant-worker after we drain the current backlog.

helen_product: Approve manual credit for this customer. Please include note about why (worker deadlock -> pubsub NACKs) and set TTL if applicable. Also include a rollback plan in case of double-grant.

maria_support: I'll proceed with the manual SQL once SRE gives the green light. Noting: customer needs credits today for trial activation.

jason_sre: Scheduling a quick maintenance window: restarting grant-worker on prod-stable at 09:20 UTC, increasing replicas to 4, draining queue. Maria, after restart if job-7f4c2 still unprocessed we do manual SQL and mark ticket with manual_grant tag. Kai, create a follow-up PR to reorder commit->emit.

kai_eng: Will open PR and include test that exercises ordering. Also adding a guard to avoid long-held DB locks.

ops-bot: deploy: grant-worker restart triggered by jason_sre at 2026-03-17T09:20:20Z.

maria_support: Confirmed with customer: they received credits after manual action at 09:32 UTC. Marking ticket resolved. Will keep monitoring. :thumbsup:

jason_sre: Root cause tracked in ENG-1268. Assign to kai_eng. Closing thread after PR merge + one-week monitor.

kai_eng: PR opened: https://repo.internal/infra/PR/834 - contains fix + tests. Monitoring metric: grant-processor:ack_rate.

maria_support: Thanks all — filing summary into SUP-8217 and adding notes for CS playbook: if grant_job stuck -> check pubsub NACKs, check worker logs for KV cache lock, and fallback to manual-grant SQL with approval.

helen_product: Good postmortem action items: add alert for ack_rate < 95% and add playbook step.

jason_sre: Closing now. If anyone sees more stuck jobs ping #eng-oncall.
